readme:
# DataForSEO Google Local Finder Advanced API

This endpoint retrieves advanced Google Local Finder search results in real time. It returns detailed local business rankings and search engine results data.

## Use cases

- Monitor local business ranking positions across Google Local Finder results.
- Gather detailed local pack and map listing data for competitive analysis.
- Track geographic visibility and presence for local branch locations.

## Request

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.sandbase.ai/v1/api/dataforseo/v3/serp/google/local_finder/live/advanced" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SANDBASE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"keyword": "coffee shop", "location_coordinate": "40.7128,-74.0060,14z", "language_code": "en"}'
```

## Parameters

The JSON body is forwarded to the upstream endpoint (one task per call). Fields used above:

| Name | Description |
|---|---|
| `keyword` | Search query. |
| `location_coordinate` | Coordinates as "latitude,longitude,zoom", e.g. "40.7128,-74.0060,14z". |
| `language_code` | Language code, e.g. "en". |

## Pricing

$0.003 per page of 10 results. The default depth (10) is one page; for example depth 50 costs 5 pages. Failed calls are not charged. Extra crawled pages, pixel rankings, async AI overview, People Also Ask clicks and search operators (site:, intitle: ...) are not supported.

## Related APIs

- [DataForSEO Backlinks Anchors](/model/dataforseo/v3/backlinks/anchors/live): Returns anchor text distribution metrics for backlinks pointing to a target website or page.
- [DataForSEO Backlinks List](/model/dataforseo/v3/backlinks/backlinks/live): Returns a list of external backlinks pointing to a specified target domain or webpage.
- [DataForSEO Backlinks Bulk Ranks](/model/dataforseo/v3/backlinks/bulk_ranks/live): Returns rank metrics for multiple domains or pages in bulk.
